testName: CRM Analytics (Tableau CRM) Data Recipe Run & Lens Dataset Validation
steps:
1. Open Analytics Studio
2. Navigate to Data Manager > Recipes
3. Open Recipe "Pipeline_Cleanse_And_Transform"
4. Click "Run Recipe" button
5. Monitor Job Monitor tab until Recipe status reaches "Success"
6. Navigate to Datasets tab and open generated dataset "Consolidated_Pipeline_DS"
7. In Analytics Lens builder, aggregate Measure by "Sum of Amount" grouped by "Account Industry"
8. Verify chart renders top 5 industries with accurate monetary values matching Core CRM records
